case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for explaining the labour and steel cost pressures, which we recognise, and for Brandlhuber's past pricing concessions and support.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Our options recognise rising costs while allowing room to distinguish recent changes from earlier underpricing. We are flexible on payment terms, with a corresponding price adjustment; please choose whichever works best for Brandlhuber.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 131.87 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 131.93 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you and your office manager separate the requested increase into recent input-cost changes and recovery of earlier underpricing, using updated plant costs?

We value our long-standing relationship and want Brandlhuber to remain a healthy, reliable partner.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. We have carefully reviewed your data regarding energy costs and have factored this decrease into our revised calculation. 

Nevertheless, the cumulative burden of labor and material expenses remains substantial and requires a sustainable adjustment to ensure our continued quality. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. 

We therefore propose a revised price of €135.50 per unit, maintaining the 30-day payment terms. Our Angebot is a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for lowering your offer and reflecting the energy cost decrease in your calculation. We recognise that labour and material pressures remain substantial and that sustainable pricing matters after your past concessions.

We have modestly improved our price offer in recognition of that support and ask for a further price concession in return. We are flexible on payment terms: Option B retains your requested payment period in exchange for the lower price; please choose the option that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 133.56 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 133.05 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 133.38 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

We value Brandlhuber’s continued support and want our long-standing relationship to remain commercially sound for you as well.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Option B: EUR 133.69 per unit, new price from 2026-11-01, payment 30 days net.
Option C: EUR 135.12 per unit, new price from 2027-01-01, payment 30 days net.

We appreciate Brandlhuber's past support and want sustainable pricing for our long-standing relationship.

Kind regards
